title: spec: a chart list view on object A accepts a dataset bound to another object or another package without refusal
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A chart view on `gapview_item` saved and published with `dataset: "showcase_task_metrics"` (a dataset over another object in another package). Nothing checks that the dataset belongs to the view's object.

## Reproduction

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/gapview_item.<name>?mode=draft&package=<pkg>` with a chart list view whose dataset is `showcase_task_metrics` → 200; publish → 200.

## Expected

Refused at save with a located error (dataset object must equal the view object, or be reachable from the package's dependency closure).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

View chart dataset validation in `packages/spec` (the list-view lint family that already checks columns, cf. #24563).

## Filing facts

- reach: `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/…`, measured twice by the view gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Authors get a chart of unrelated data under an object's list without any warning.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:spec`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `chart list view dataset of another object accepted without check` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 6 hits, none for a foreign dataset (nearest closed #22491 missing dataset, #24563 field references).
- QA id: S5
